title: Pakistan Partners to Reduce Antibiotic Use in Poultry
excerpt: Pakistan signs a research deal with Denmark's ICARS to address antimicrobial resistance involving chicken farming.
body_html:
Pakistan has entered into a research agreement with the Denmark-based International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions, known as ICARS.

The partnership aims to address the issue of antimicrobial resistance. Specifically, the initiative focuses on efforts to stop the use of antibiotics on chicken.
